start.title: Getting started
start.q1: How do I choose my course?
start.a1: On your first login the app asks for a course and a sub-course. You can change it any time from Profile → Edit Profile.
start.q2: Is the app free to use?
start.a2: Most practice material is free. A few exam sets and premium notes need a purchase, and that is always marked on the card before you open it.
start.q3: Do I need internet all the time?
start.a3: Internet is needed to load new content and to save your progress. Pages you already opened stay readable from cache for a short while.

study.title: Study & practice
study.q1: Where do I practise a subject?
study.a1: Open Subjects, pick a subject, then a chapter and a unit, and choose Read or Practice.
study.q2: Can I save a question for later?
study.a2: Yes. Tap the bookmark icon on any question or article. Everything you save is in Profile → Bookmarks.
study.q3: Why does it say my bookmark slots are full?
study.a3: Each sub-course allows 15 bookmarks. Remove one from the Bookmarks page to free a slot.

exams.title: Exams
exams.q1: When can I start an exam set?
exams.a1: A scheduled set unlocks at its start time. The countdown on the card shows exactly when that is.
exams.q2: What happens if I leave an exam midway?
exams.a2: The timer keeps running. Come back before it ends and your answers are still there.
exams.q3: Where do I see my rank?
exams.a3: Once results are published, open the Ranking tab on that exam, or the Leaderboard tab for the overall standing.

daily.title: Daily Test
daily.q1: How often can I take the Daily Test?
daily.a1: Once a day. A fresh set arrives each morning and the previous one closes.
daily.a2: Yes. They feed your points, your streak and Analytics exactly like any other activity.
daily.q3: I missed yesterday — can I still take it?
daily.a3: Past Daily Tests cannot be reopened. Missing one only breaks your streak; the points you already earned stay.

current.title: Current affairs
current.q1: Where does the GK material come from?
current.a1: Our team prepares and publishes it. New notes appear under GK & Current Affairs.
current.a2: New material is added regularly, and the app sends you a notification when it lands.
current.a3: Yes. The list keeps earlier entries — scroll down or use the topic filter to find them.

progress.title: Progress & points
progress.q1: How is my profile percentage calculated?
progress.a1: It is coverage: how much of all available content you have completed. It is not your accuracy — accuracy is shown as a separate number.
progress.q2: Why did my percentage go down?
progress.a2: When new content is added the total grows, so the same work covers a smaller share. It climbs back as you keep studying.
progress.a3: A snapshot is stored once a day, so today's activity can take a few hours to appear in the trend charts.

account.title: Account
account.q1: Can I use one account on two phones?
account.a1: No. An account works on one device at a time. Logging in somewhere else signs the older device out.
account.q2: How do I change my name or photo?
account.a2: Go to Profile → Edit Profile, update the field and save.
account.q3: How do I delete my account?
account.a3: Write to us from Help Center → Contact us and we will remove it for you.

app.title: App & settings
app.q1: How do I switch language or theme?
app.a1: Both live in Settings — the language toggle, and Light, Dark or System theme.
app.a2: Allow notifications for the app in your phone settings, then open the app once so it can register this device.
app.q3: How do I report a problem?
app.a3: Help Center → Report a problem, or tap the report icon on the screen where the problem happened.
